validation_scenarios.name: audience reframe with preserved artifact

turns.prompt:
Create a sample contamination chain and timeline for a university lab safety review. This is a presentation artifact, not an interactive dashboard. Keep it as one sample contamination chain and timeline in the first viewport.

Situation: Lab: Microbial Ecology Core. Samples S-21, S-22, S-23, incubator I4, hood H2, reagent lot R9, sequencing queue Q5, PI review.
Current state: S-22 contamination red, S-21 questionable amber, S-23 clean, I4 temperature excursion 2.1C, H2 airflow normal, R9 lot under review, Q5 paused.
Timeline: 07:20 plate check, 08:10 temp excursion, 09:00 reagent pull, 10:15 sequencing pause, 11:30 PI review, 13:00 rerun plan.
Sources: S1 plate image log, S2 incubator telemetry, S3 reagent record, S4 hood cert, S5 sequencing queue, S6 PI note.

Requirements: 1. The first viewport must be dominated by one coherent visual artifact, not a grid of detached KPI cards. 2. Show the main entities, current states, source markers S1-S6, timeline, legend, and four connected callouts. 3. The callouts must cover S-22 contamination, I4 excursion, R9 review, Q5 pause. 4. Use polished domain-appropriate styling with readable labels and no critical overlap.

Reframe it for the PI. Preserve the contamination chain; add exactly three decisions: rerun S-22, quarantine R9, release S-23. Add two leader-linked lenses for incubator excursion and reagent lot risk.

Apply 12:40 correction: H2 airflow is found low, R9 is cleared, S-21 is clean, S-22 remains contaminated, Q5 resumes for clean samples. Synchronize chain, decisions, source tags, callouts, and timeline. Do not leave R9 under review.
Create an IRB-safe lab incident appendix. Fit chain, sample ledger, source tags S1-S6, confidence markers, and timeline in the first viewport.
Add a bench-tech handoff note beside the appendix. It must preserve H2 low airflow, R9 cleared, S-21 clean, S-22 contaminated, Q5 resumed, and source markers.
